name: Oberlin Inter-Regional Rumble
headline: Oberlin Inter-Regional Rumble
summary: Final: Men: Case Western Reserve won with 24 points, ahead of DePauw (146) and Baldwin Wallace (154), and the Spartans' Jacob Slater won the 8K in 25:19.3. Women: Case Western Reserve scored 42 to beat DePauw (99) and Denison (107), and St. Mary's (Ind.) Adelaide Lulich won in 22:19.7.
